quote: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol on September 29 at its annual DevDay developer conference.
kind_note: shipped model (API model ID gpt-6.1-sol; an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, positioned below GPT-6 Astra)
note: Lab and kind notes confirmed. Availability at launch: API and ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid tiers, not standard ChatGPT chat (per Unite.ai and gradually.ai; a Korean report says not offered in the EU or UK at launch). Corroborating: gradually.ai lists 'Released' 'September 29, 2026' (label-value layout, not a sentence; https://www.gradually.ai/en/ai-models/gpt-6.1-sol/). 9to5Mac's DevDay coverage dated September 29, 2026 quotes OpenAI's announcement ('We're introducing GPT-6.1 Sol, an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol that nearly matches GPT-6 Astra's intelligence on agentic coding, ...', https://9to5mac.com/?p=1071923). One Japanese outlet (gori.me) and ProPakistani (2026-09-30) are dated the 30th, likely due to time zones. Could not open openai.com (ProPakistani returned HTTP 403 and openai.com was not reached directly), so the date rests on secondary coverage quoting OpenAI's announcement; the primary OpenAI post was not opened. Not to be confused with GPT-6 Sol (released 2026-09-22 per one source) or the unreleased GPT-6.1 Astra, which OpenAI withdrew on 2026-09-28.
